### Ranked Defects in [prompt.md](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md)

1. **[prompt.md](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L48), [L63-L64](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L63-L64) — Axis 1 & 7 (Pass while wrong / Measurement): Forward fallback can pass the kill table with vacuous sets.** When no backward set reaches `A` (as on `redfakemaze`, [L56](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L56)), the start state "fails to enter the next set" ([L48](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L48)), opening forward exact-state search from `A` — which now has [L45-L47](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L45-L47)'s $100\times$ faster lookup and no body-block branching. Furthermore, "moves" ([L63](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L63)) is undefined (in [3.2e-probes/last.md](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2e-probes/last.md#L9), `fencemaze`'s set estimate moved `38 → 55` with no arriving sentence), and the 8 solved tracks (6 slower than Julien, [planner-premises/last.md](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/planner-premises/last.md#L19)) have no non-regression guard.
   - *Fix:* Define "moves" as a certified sentence arriving (or lower certified `T`) with $\ge 1$ switch entered via a backward set; require non-regression on the 8 solved tracks; report switches resolved by backward sets vs exact-state fallback.

2. **[prompt.md](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L26-L28), [L66](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L66) — Axis 4 (Invitation to patch): The `acos` `NaN` rule demands the impossible from corner checks.** At `movement.rs:802-803`, `dot / sqrt(a*b) > 1.0` is an interior 1-ulp rounding ripple on $0^\circ$ collinear vectors where all 16 corners can evaluate to `0.0` (`minor = true`, sprint kept) while an interior point evaluates to `NaN` (`minor = false`, sprint lost) or vice versa ([check.md](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/lab/results/local-20261113-1727-1-0-monotone-tick/check.md#L56-L67)). A builder cannot locate or split that interior ulp from corners ([L27](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L27)) nor drop a set when all corners lose sprint ([L28](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L28)).
   - *Fix:* Specify that whenever a set has `horizontal_collision = true`, its bound must union both branches of `minor_horizontal_collision` (`true` and `false` at `movement.rs:802-803`) instead of trusting corner `acos` evaluations.

3. **[prompt.md](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L34), [L38](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L38) vs [L58](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L58) — Axis 3 & 6 (Assumed-away open question / Overspecification): Step 3 contradicts Step 5.4 and forbids multi-segment run-ups.** Saying *"A run-up is the per-tick rule applied k times, nothing more"* ([L38](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L38)) and computing takeoffs from `(v_start, program, k, f)` ([L34](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L34)) assumes an event-free flat stretch, which fails on the 1,596 single-axis wall-release ticks and 1,587 sneak edge-backoff ticks ([dossier.md](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/lab/results/local-20261113-0958-1-0-generative-function/dossier.md#L25-L30), [L58](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L58)), omits [arc-certificate](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/lab/results/local-20261112-1251-1-0-arc-certificate/dossier.md#L31-L34)'s single-binade restriction, and forbids run-ups across step-ups or wall contacts ([3.2f-b-joints/last.md](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2f-b-joints/last.md#L9-L31)).
   - *Fix:* Restrict closed-rule `(v_start, program, k, f)` evaluation to single-binade stretches proved free of wall-contact and sneak-edge reads; otherwise propagate sets through the ticked law across segments.

4. **[prompt.md](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L17), [L19](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L19), [L26](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L26), [L48](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L48) — Axis 2 (Dropped constraints #1 & #2): End-to-end replay certification on every return path and exact-state closed sets are not explicitly mandated.** Unlike [3.2b/prompt.md](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2b-planner/prompt.md#L31), [L26](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L26) only mentions "the final replay decides" under corner checks, leaving joint slides ([L19](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L19)) and anytime returns unguarded, and [L48](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L48) does not state that fallback search's closed set must never merge by class or set ([planner-premises/last.md](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/planner-premises/last.md#L3-L4)).
   - *Fix:* Add Audit Constraints #1 and #2 verbatim: every returned or slide-accepted sentence must be certified by an end-to-end law replay from the exact start state, and closed sets use exact states only.

5. **[prompt.md](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L18), [L62](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L62), [L64](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L64) — Axis 2 & 7 (Dropped constraint #5 / Measurement gaming): Pre-built table keys, budget accounting, and baseline definition can be gamed.** [L18](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L18) allows excluding pre-built tables from `T` without forbidding fixture/goal-dependent keys, and does not require counting post-click compilation against the cap 1 / cap 20 **stopping budget** ([3.2b-judge/last.md](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2b-judge/last.md#L7)). Also, [L62](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L62) ("3.2b baseline with step 0's fixes") literally includes Step 0.3 (the new solver) while omitting Step 4's lookup/tube fixes, and [L64](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L64) conflates movement `T` from leaving `A` ([ladder.md](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/docs/ladder.md#L16)) with click-to-arrival `T`.
   - *Fix:* Require pre-built tables to be world- and goal-independent (built once before any track loads); include all post-click work in the cap 1/20 budget; define the baseline as 3.2b Mode 3 + Mode 5 with fixes 0.1, 0.2, 0.4, class-only lookup, and walked-tube check; report movement `T` (leaving `A` $\to$ `B`), thinking `T`, sum `T`, `LB`/`UB` bracket, and distributions (`min, p50, p90, p99, max`).

6. **[prompt.md](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L19), [L24](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L24), [L32](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L32), [L46-L48](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L46-L48) — Axis 4, 5 & 6 (Underspecification / Overspecification / Patch trap): Set coordinates, backward unit, preimage direction, and fallback target are ambiguous.** [L24](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L24) requires a "supporting surface face" (excluding airborne sets needed by [L57](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L57) and sub-face `[x, z]` intervals cut by collision boxes); [L32](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L32) says "preimage" without noting the law has no inverse step ([learning.md](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/docs/learning.md#L18-L30), tempting float-inversion epsilons); and [L19](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L19), [L46-L48](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L46-L48) leave undefined whether a backward step is a segment or a jump (run-up + arc), what decision variables "choose a point / slide a joint" adjusts (`(k, aim)` vs spatial points), how aim is solved on the 64-yaw grid without "new geometry code" ([L66](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L66)), and whether fallback search ([L48](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L48)) targets the next backward set or `B`.
   - *Fix:* Define a set's spatial bound as a `[x, y, z]` box (on a support face or in air) cut by law comparisons; state that preimages are computed by forward monotone evaluation without float inversion; specify that forward choice and joint sliding select `(k, aim)` (angular yaw-bin span + local refinement) to enter the next takeoff set, and fallback search targets entry into the next reachable backward set (or `B`).

7. **[prompt.md](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/jobs/3.2d-sets/prompt.md#L68) — Axis 2 (Dropped constraint #18/#19 & known broken doctest):** `cargo test --offline` currently fails on `walk.rs:4`'s `law::Refusal` doctest ([HANDOFF.md](file:///C:/Users/PASCAL/Desktop/path%20tracing/docs/HANDOFF.md#L38)) and omits the footprint mutation gate (`jobs/1.2-footprints/verify.ps1`, 12/12 mutants) and evidence record path.
